Container.Name: keylife-import
Container.Overview:
Keeps a WP All Import job running on a schedule without anyone having to click anything. Calls the WP All Import processing endpoint every 2 minutes and the trigger endpoint every 4 hours, which is the cadence WP All Import's own cron documentation describes.
The WebUI shows a live countdown to the next run, whether an import is currently working, request and error counts, and the raw responses from the site. It also has a Run Import Now button and a Pause toggle.
The first visit to the WebUI asks for the Access Token and remembers it in a cookie.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the status page.

Config.Name: State Directory
Config.Description: Stores the last trigger time so restarting the container does not re-run an import. Safe to leave at the default.

Config.Name: Import Key
Config.Description: The import_key secret from the WP All Import cron settings page.

Config.Name: Access Token
Config.Description: Password for the status page. Leave blank to let anyone on the network open it.

Config.Name: Import ID
Config.Description: Which WP All Import job to run.

Config.Name: Site URL
Config.Description: Full URL to wp-load.php on the WordPress site.

Config.Name: Processing Interval (seconds)
Config.Description: How often to call the processing endpoint. 120 = every 2 minutes. Raise this if the web host complains about the load.

Config.Name: Trigger Interval (seconds)
Config.Description: How often to queue a fresh import. 14400 = every 4 hours.

Config.Name: Page Title
Config.Description: Heading shown on the status page.

Config.Name: Trigger On Start
Config.Description: Queue an import as soon as the container first starts. Ignored once a trigger time has been saved to the state directory.

Config.Name: Scheduler Enabled
Config.Description: Set to false to start paused. The Pause button on the status page does the same thing at runtime.

Config.Name: Idle Response Pattern
Config.Description: Advanced. Regex matching a processing response that means no import is running. Only affects the status badge, not the schedule. Leave blank for the built-in default.
